import sys, json, subprocess, resource, os, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
import perf
# regenerate the largest doc: P2
import random
rnd = random.Random(3)
def hexs(n, seed=0):
    return "".join("%02x" % ((i * 7 + seed) % 256) for i in range(n))
evs = []
for i in range(3750):
    frames = [{"type": "STREAM", "id": (j % 8) * 4, "offset": rnd.randrange(0, 40000),
               "data_hex": hexs(rnd.choice([0, 8, 32])), "fin": False} for j in range(16)]
    evs.append(perf.dg(i, 1200, [perf.pk("A", i, frames)]))
doc = {"version": 1, "traces": [perf.trace("p2", evs, max_stream_data=65536,
                                           max_data=perf.MAXN, overlap="first")]}
inp = json.dumps(doc).encode()
# measure peak RSS of the child
cmd = [sys.executable, "-I", "-c",
       "import resource,sys,runpy;\n"
       "sys.argv=['entry.py']\n"
       "import importlib.util\n"
       "spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('__main__','/app/submission/entry.py')\n"
       "m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n"
       "spec.loader.exec_module(m)\n"
       "try:\n    m.main()\nfinally:\n    print(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss, file=sys.stderr)"]
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run(cmd, input=inp, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
dt = time.time()-t0
print("peak rss child (KB reported):", p.stderr.decode().strip(), "time %.2fs" % dt,
      "out bytes", len(p.stdout), "rc", p.returncode)
EOF
